admission.justification: Delivering a deterministic, script-off-readable, verified static VitePress site requires fail-closed Markdown transforms, atomic compiler rendering, MathJax 3 editorial light components and dual-repo CI/Pages isolation to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-build-site and VitePress against validated Stage 00 docs, Concept Cards, SVG assets, audit snapshots and DAG data deterministically produces a script-off-readable, build-time MathJax 3 editorial light static site without mutating .vitepress/, guarded on every code PR by quality.yml site-build-check and deployed from ar-rh-proof-skeleton.
title: Phase 4 deterministic static-site compiler, VitePress theme and dual-repo CI
